definitions.full: H7171. qerets קֶ֫רֶץ noun masculine dubious word, apparently nipping , concrete nipper usually interpreted (since Hi) of a nipping or stinging insect (compare Aramaic קָרוֺצָא , Arabic biting insect ); e.g. gadfly (compare Thes Add. 111 ), figurative of Nebuchadr. ׳ק בָּא מִצָּפוֺן Jer 46:20 a gadfly cometh from the north ; ᵑ9 (Aq Symm) stimulator , i.e. קֹרֵץ ; Thes and others, more Generally, excidium.
